messages:
Rivka (CSM): Heads-up: Sunshore active seats collapsed from ~60% to 11% since their new ML lead rotated in. Procurement mentioned a cost review and I saw notes about a competitor pilot. Need a quick renewal triage.
alerts-bot: alert account=sunshore metric=active_seats drop=49pct window=4d severity=high
Darin (AM): Any logs or error spikes? Cost vs quality signal?
Rivka (CSM): Found two signals: p50 latency doubled in eu-central and a handful of SDK warnings: 'kv_cache miss -> unbatched path' in staging around 03/14. Procurement asked for a cost breakdown.
Jun (Solutions): If it's KV/cache we can offer a config tweak and a short replay to validate. I can prepare a small repro and a recommended patch. ETA 14h.
Maya (Sales): If it's a cost pilot we should offer a 4-week Dedicated trial with a conditional price-lock and a one-pager for procurement. I can draft the collateral.
Darin (AM): Outline next steps: 1) Jun builds patch and repro 2) Maya drafts procurement ROI 3) Rivka sends a low-friction outreach to the ML lead (cc @oliver_sunshore) asking whether the pilot is latency/cost/accuracy-focused. Follow-up in 48h. I'll track timeline.
Rivka (CSM): Message sent: 'Oliver 12 quick check: is the new pilot focused on latency/cost? We can run a short Dedicated proof + tuning if helpful.' Waiting.
alerts-bot: note historical p50 latency=90ms current p50=210ms
Jun (Solutions): I'll try a kv_cache threshold bump and a batching window tweak. If staging latency drops we'll propose the change as a quick mitigation.
Rivka (CSM): Oliver replied: 'Mainly cost & latency. Open to a pilot if it shows predictable spend and stable p50 <120ms.' Moving to pilot prep.
Maya (Sales): Great. I'll coordinate pricing ops and get the procurement one-pager to Rivka by EOD.
Darin (AM): Thanks team. Keep updates here; if the patch helps we can use that to de-risk renewal while the procurement talk proceeds.
